OAR.name: Wooden Oar
physical_traits: word BOSUN carved into the wood
key_facts: Primary melee weapon used by the Mariner
Has the word BOSUN carved into it
Edged with metal for combat use
Dripping with blood from multiple fights
Taken from Mariner before the final confrontation

PURSE.name: Rose's Purse
key_facts: Contains a hidden chip with the blockchain password
Password is tied to roughly $20 million in stolen gang money on a blockchain
Rose stole the money from Salvatori's gang
Rose goes back into danger to retrieve it
Found on the desk on the 15th floor
Primary MacGuffin driving the second half of the plot

AIRTAG.name: AirTag
key_facts: Secretly stashed by Mariner in Rose's purse the previous Thanksgiving
How Mariner tracked Rose to the Ruddy & Greene Building
Rose immediately insists they return for the purse after learning about it
Rose turns it back on Mariner: 'Who got you involved, Mr. Fucking AirTag?'
Reveals that Mariner tracked his sister without her knowledge

MEMORY STICK.name: Memory Stick
key_facts: Carries the blockchain password Rose says is tied to her life savings
Hidden on a chip in the lining of Rose's purse
Tied to roughly $20 million that Rose stole from the gang
Salvatori demands the memory stick from Rose

FLARE GUN.name: Flare Gun
key_facts: Mariner carries it as a maritime-themed weapon
The thugs identify it as a flare gun and laugh before Mariner fires it
Used to shoot Vinnie in the chest on the 13th floor
The fired flare continues burning on Vinnie's chest and casts stark red light during the fight

BEER BOTTLES.name: Beer Bottles
physical_traits: empty beer bottles littering the bottom of the boat
must_mention_scenes: BEGIN FLASHBACK: EXT. COASTLINE - DAY - PAST
key_facts: Young Mariner fetches a beer for Dad in the idealized coastline memory
The revealed backyard is strewn with discarded bottles, and Dad kicks one hard enough to smash it against the stucco
The revealed coastline memory shows the boat bottom littered with empty beer bottles while Dad tells Mariner to fetch another

BENCH PRESS.name: Bench Press
must_mention_scenes: BEGIN FLASHBACK: EXT. BACKYARD - DAY - PAST
key_facts: In Mariner's idealized memory, Dad patiently teaches him to bench press and helps him succeed
In the revealed flashback, Dad sends Mariner to lift weights after punching him
The later backyard shows the bench press repaired with peeling duct-tape among rusty weights
